sources.entry: Slink - Image sharing platform designed to give users complete control over their media sharing experience. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Slink is a self-hosted image sharing platform built with Symfony and SvelteKit, offering private shares, collections, and admin moderation.
summary.what_it_does: Slink lets users upload images (PNG, JPG, WEBP, SVG, GIF, AVIF, and others) and share them via links that are private by default. Shares can be password-protected, set to expire, or shortened into short URLs. Users can group images into collections, organize them with nested tags, and browse publicly visible images through an Explore page. It supports email/password login, OIDC/SSO providers, user approval gating, API keys, and a public API. Administrators get a statistics dashboard, user and settings management, image moderation, and storage tracking across local, SMB, and AWS S3 storage providers.
use_cases: share screenshots with friends or colleagues
host images for GitHub, blogs, or portfolios
how_to_run: See the official documentation for installation steps (the README links to Installation and Configuration docs but does not include commands).
notable: Privacy-first shares with optional password protection and expiration
Collections for sharing a group of images via one link
SSO/OIDC support for Google, Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, Pocket ID, and custom providers
Storage backends for local disk, SMB, and AWS S3
ShareX integration and deduplication on upload
caveats: Installation details are only available in the external documentation, not the README
HEIC and TIFF support is marked with an asterisk in the README, suggesting limited support (the asterisk is not explained)
